context: The existing profile deliberately selects only two defaults with path scopes, one loose local lens, and one lens inside a different local plugin. Creation copies all four defaults into the package, replaces only the two selected default refs, and adds a scoped bespoke lens without discarding settings or widening coverage. The other plugin must not be mistaken for an existing local/code-review package.
